arxiv-2306-02687.title: A Monolithic Hyper ROM FE 2 Method with Clustered Training at Finite Deformations Journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
arxiv-2306-02687.creator: Nils Lange, Geralf Hütter, Bjoern Kiefer
arxiv-2306-02687.description: Abstract The usage of numerical homogenization to obtain structure-property relations using the finite element method at both the micro and macroscale has gained much interest in the research community. However the computational cost of this so called FE 2 method is so high that algorithmic modifications and reduction methods are essential. Currently the authors proposed a monolithic algorithm.

arxiv-2405-20863.title: ABodyBuilder3: Improved and scalable antibody structure predictions
arxiv-2405-20863.creator: Henry Kenlay, Frédéric A. Dreyer, Daniel Cutting, Daniel Nissley, Charlotte M. Deane
arxiv-2405-20863.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of antibody structure is a central task in the design and development of monoclonal antibodies, notably to understand both their developability and their binding properties. In this article, we introduce ABodyBuilder3, an improved and scalable antibody structure prediction model based on ImmuneBuilder.

arxiv-2407-20397.title: Results from ON-OFF analysis of the Neutrinos-Angra detector
arxiv-2407-20397.creator: E. Kemp, W. V. Santos, J. C. Anjos, P. Chimenti, L. F. G. Gonzalez, G. P. Guedes, H. P. Lima Jr, R. A. Nóbrega, I. M. Pepe, D. B. S. Ribeiro
arxiv-2407-20397.description: Abstract The Neutrinos Angra Experiment, a water-based Cherenkov detector, is located at the Angra dos Reis nuclear power plant in Brazil. Designed to detect electron antineutrinos produced in the nuclear reactor, the primary objective of the experiment is to demonstrate the feasibility of monitoring reactor activity using an antineutrino detector.

arxiv-2505-02930.title: Orbital Entanglement and The Double d d -Shell Effect in Binary Transition Metal Molecules
arxiv-2505-02930.creator: Julianne S. Lampert, Timothy J. Krogmeier, Anthony W. Schlimgen, Kade Head-Marsden
arxiv-2505-02930.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Julianne S. Lampert, Timothy J. Krogmeier, Anthony W. Schlimgen, Kade Head-Marsden. Accurate modeling of transition metal-containing compounds is of great interest due to their wide-ranging and significant applications. These systems present several challenges from an electronic structure perspective, including significant multi-reference character and many chemically-relevant orbitals. A further complication arises from the so-called double d d -shell effect, which is known to cause a myriad of issues in the treatment of first-row transition metals with both single- and multi-reference methods.

arxiv-2508-17685.title: Water structuring at stacked graphene interfaces unveiled by machine-learning molecular dynamics
arxiv-2508-17685.creator: Dianwei Hou, Yevhen Horbatenko, Stefan Ringe, Minhaeng Cho
arxiv-2508-17685.description: Abstract The wettability of monolayer and multilayer graphene remains a topic of longstanding debate. Here, we combined first-principles molecular dynamics simulations accelerated with the atomic cluster expansion machine learning interatomic potential to investigate how substrate, graphene layer number, and intercalated water molecules influence graphene’s wettability.

pmc-10618874.title: Spatial–temporal evolution and correlation analysis between habitat quality and landscape patterns based on land use change in Shaanxi Province, China
pmc-10618874.creator: Li Gu, Jiabo Yan, Yurong Li, Zhiwen Gong
pmc-10618874.description: Regional habitat quality is an important reflection of ecosystem services and ecosystem health. Exploring the characteristics of habitat quality changes and revealing the vulnerability of regional ecosystems caused could provide reference for the improvement of ecological service functions and the protection of regional ecological environment.

pmc-11317482.title: Real-time cognitive performance metrics derived from a digital therapeutic for inattention predict ADHD-related clinical outcomes: Replication across three independent trials of AKL-T01
pmc-11317482.creator: Caitlin A. Stamatis, Andrew C. Heusser, Tony J. Simon, Titiimaea Ala’ilima, Scott H. Kollins
pmc-11317482.description: AKL-T01 is a digital therapeutic (DTx) that targets attention by generating conflict at dynamically updated difficulty levels during a multitasking game. Clinical trials support AKL-T01’s efficacy in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), but there is a need to understand how in-game data can be used to monitor patient changes in cognition.

pmc-11493670.title: Role of SARS-CoV-2-specific memory B cells promoting immune protection after booster vaccination in solid organ transplantation
pmc-11493670.creator: Laura Donadeu, Susana Gomez-Olles, Franc Casanova, Alba Torija, Manuel Lopez-Meseguer, Meritxell Boada-Pérez, Delphine Kervella, Elena Crespo, Claudia Carrera-Muñoz, Isabel Campos-Varela, Lluís Castells, Maria F. Cortese, Juliana Esperalba, Candela Fernández-Naval, Jesús Quintero, Marina Muñoz, Fern
pmc-11493670.description: IntroductionSolid organ transplant (SOT) recipients display weak seroconversion and neutralizing antibody (NAb) responses after severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) vaccination and remain at risk of severe coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). While B-cell memory is the hallmark of serological immunity, its role in driving successful vaccine responses and providing immune protection in SOT patients remains unclear.

pmc-11676116.title: Enhancing Morchella Mushroom Yield and Quality Through the Amendment of Soil Physicochemical Properties and Microbial Community with Wood Ash
pmc-11676116.creator: Kai Huang, Ling Li, Weijun Wu, Kunlun Pu, Wei Qi, Jianzhao Qi, Minglei Li
pmc-11676116.description: Morchella mushroom is a nutritionally rich and rare edible fungus. The traditional cultivation model, which relies on expanding the cultivation area to meet market demand, is no longer sufficient to address the rapidly growing market demand. Enhancing the yield and quality of Morchella without increasing the cultivation area is an intractable challenge in the development of the Morchella mushroom industry.

pmc-12508111.title: Road safety measurement with reliability using an advanced hybrid decision model
pmc-12508111.creator: Jiaxu Jin, Hanrui Feng, Haojing Gao, Hongyang Hua, Mingshuo Liu, Hedong Liang, Hongping Qi, Lei Sun, Fang Tian, Jiachen Yao, Aaron Kaiqiang Zhou, Yiyun Zhang, Xingjian Zhang, Ziyan Li, Dongxu Qin, Mingren Zheng, Haocheng Yang, Faan Chen
pmc-12508111.description: This study proposes a brand-new hybrid multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) framework that combines High-Dimensional Vector Projection (HDVP) and Between-class Variance Maximization (BeVarMax), termed the HDVP–BeVarMax model, aiming to provide trustworthy decisions and defensible policy conclusions. Specifically, HDVP quantifies the relative proximity of each country to an ideal performance vector in a high-dimensional space, ensuring scale-invariant and geometrically meaningful aggregation.

pmc-12970314.title: Intracranial erosion of an occipitocervical rod through the foramen magnum following occipitocervical fusion for retro-odontoid pannus: illustrative case
pmc-12970314.creator: Arun Gunasekaran, Fielding Horne, Maxwell Sheedy, Brian Fabian Saway, Joel Sirianni, Steven L Morgan, Amanda L Faulkner
pmc-12970314.description: BACKGROUNDRetro-odontoid pannus can cause craniocervical instability and cervicomedullary compression. Occipitocervical fusion (OCF) is an established treatment, but hardware-related complications remain significant. Intracranial rod migration through the foramen magnum is exceedingly rare and poses substantial neurological risk.OBSERVATIONSA 76-year-old man with retro-odontoid pannus and progressive myelopathy underwent OCF. Months later, he developed wound complications and mechanical failure.

pmc-13110722.title: Molecular mechanisms of folliculogenesis and oogenesis
pmc-13110722.creator: Mohamed Aboul Ezz, Ahmed Zaky Balboula
pmc-13110722.description: Folliculogenesis is a complex, multi-stage process crucial for the establishment and maintenance of female fertility through the production of a developmentally competent oocyte. Folliculogenesis, including follicular formation, activation, growth and maturation, relies on a finely tuned spatiotemporal crosstalk between germ cells, somatic cells, and the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis.

pmc-13355363.title: “It’s more than just blood pressure and stitches”: a critical examination of paramedic services from the perspectives of intimate partner violence advocates
pmc-13355363.creator: Rory A Marshall, Tori N Stranges, Nicole Merritt, Keilin Gorman, Stephen Bartlett, Simon Sawyer, Paul van Donkelaar
pmc-13355363.description: BackgroundAs a detrimental and persistent criminal, social, and health issue, intimate partner violence (IPV) is a severe threat to the well-being of survivors. The healthcare system, specifically the emergency department, has provided access to services and supports for survivors of IPV when seeking healthcare. However, many survivors of IPV are unable to attend the hospital and access the corresponding services.
